title: Rescue by Ropes
description: U.S. Air Force Airmen from the 125th Fighter Wing, Florida Air National Guard, conduct rescue hoist training on a building at Volk Field Combat Readiness Training Center, Wisconsin, Aug. 26, 2026, during Patriot 26. Patriot 26, an Air National Guard-hosted exercise taking place at Volk Field Combat CRTC, brings together approximately 1,000 Airmen and Soldiers from National Guard units across 35 states, along with federal, state and local agencies, to enhance domestic response readiness and interagency coordination during large-scale emergencies. The scenario allows aircrews to practice locating, hoisting and evacuating simulated patients from areas where terrain or other conditions may prevent an aircraft from landing. (U.S. Army National Guard video by Sgt. 1st Class Brittany Conley)
